embeddedResourcePolicy.sourceManifestSelection: all entries whose classification is embedded-profile-source

conformanceScope.machinePrecondition: Disposable Windows machine with the exact signed HID driver package preinstalled and no other HIDMaestro consumer or device present.

feedbackBoundary: The intended boundary is raw HMController.OutputReceived packets. The pure DualSense reduction contract and managed adapter source are frozen, HMOutputPacket.ReportId is separate, and HMOutputPacket.Data excludes that report-ID byte. The source verifiers do not compile or execute the adapter against the 16 vectors, the S1.5e observation leaf is source-frozen but its Actions observation is not established, and no behavior proof is claimed. The broader OutputDecoded surface is not required for this checkpoint.

implementationSafetySummary.note: Selected safety requirements only. The authoritative manifest exhaustively classifies every upstream unit and every planned candidate unit.

requirements: Constructor performs no background work, process launch, file extraction, driver probe, service mutation or global cleanup.
CreateController accepts only the exact conformance profile and refuses a second live controller.
A failed creation leaves its exact recovery action owned by the context, blocks another create, and is retried by Dispose.
Dispose tears down only the exact owned device set returned by create.
Create only the one plain-HID parent required by dualsense after proving the signed package was preinstalled.
Capture the exact parent instance identity immediately when registration succeeds, before any later fallible binding or child-discovery step.
Retain exact-owned recovery state and a serialized retry action until creation either commits or exact-identity rollback completes.

On every error after registration, neutralize any started state path and roll back only the exact captured parent and child identities; report rollback failure explicitly instead of discarding ownership state.
Return an immutable owned-device record containing the exact parent instance ID and exact child IDs observed from that parent.
Never enumerate or delete devices by ControllerIndex, VID/PID, HIDMaestro token, profile family or global orphan status.
Retain the immutable owned-device record for the controller lifetime.
Dispose first neutralizes and stops owned shared-memory pumps, then removes only retained exact instance IDs.
Accept HMOutputPacket.ReportId and HMOutputPacket.Data as separate inputs; never index Data as though it contains the report-ID byte.
Validate source, report ID and exact packet length before reading valid flags, motor bytes or optional fields.
Freeze every byte coordinate against the pinned upstream encoder/decoder source and cross-language golden vectors, including motor-stop and partial-validity cases.
Emit a complete effective feedback snapshot so bounded queue loss cannot resurrect stale motor state.
Encode a complete 64-byte legacy USB input report with report ID 0x01 at byte zero from the frozen source-derived DualSense input contract.

Clear every report before encoding, reject non-finite axes, clamp finite axes to [0,1], multiply by 255 and truncate, and preserve the frozen hat, button and analog-trigger-to-digital-trigger mapping.
Pass only bytes 1 through 63 to the legacy shared-memory endpoint; the configured driver prepends the report-ID byte.
Disable default compile and resource globs.
Compile an explicit source allowlist.
Embed only the hash-pinned profile catalog; never run PackResources or DownloadFile.
Encode a complete 17-byte Bluetooth input report with no report ID from the frozen source-derived xbox-series-xs-bt input contract.

Clear every report before encoding, reject non-finite axes, clamp finite axes to [0,1], truncate against each field's own logical maximum, and preserve the frozen 16-bit stick, 10-bit trigger, button-map, logical 1..8 hat and System Main Menu mappings.

Read every axis by physical semantic rather than by descriptor letter, because the host state mapper populates HMAxis with a DualSense-shaped assignment that disagrees with this descriptor on four of six axes.
Encode a complete 12-byte Bluetooth report 0x3F with the report ID at byte zero from the frozen source-derived switch-pro input contract.

Clear every report before encoding, reject non-finite axes, clamp finite axes to [0,1], truncate against 65535, and preserve the frozen sixteen-bit axis, null-state hat, positional face-button and digital ZL/ZR mappings.
Encode only report 0x3F; the 0x21/0x30 and 0x31-0x33 vendor blobs are not described field by field by the descriptor and are never synthesized.

unresolvedArtifactGates: Build the frozen replacement-source candidate in an isolated Actions directory and prove the assembly's public metadata exactly matches the nine-type source API contract.
Inspect the built artifact and prove its compile closure contains exactly the frozen explicit source allowlist and no implicit or generated authority-bearing unit.
Prove the candidate's 228 raw manifest resources derive from the frozen profile-source manifest and reproduce the required catalog framing.
Execute an isolated cross-language artifact check proving the managed raw DualSense feedback adapter matches all 16 frozen Rust golden vectors over separate ReportId and Data coordinates.
Execute an isolated artifact check proving the managed DualSense input encoder matches all 37 source-derived frames and that the shared endpoint receives exactly wire bytes 1 through 63.
Bind driver.h and driver.c layout/lifecycle facts to the exact signed installed HID driver binary and catalog consumed by the runtime.
Freeze the complete native-bootstrap, managed-host, runtimeconfig, deps and self-contained runtime file graph with stable file identities, hashes and signer policy.
